question.problem: Given that $u=[\begin{aligned}a \\ b \\ c\end{aligned}]$ is a non-zero  vector that is orthogonal to the set $W=\{[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ -2\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 0 \\ -10\end{aligned}]\},$ find the value of $\frac{a+c}{b}.$

current_example.problem: Given that ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14275210/assets/cf00fe0deeb701aac6d3cbecdc6740eeb99e414f06dfa2496b78179de4ba42c6.svg) is a non-zero vector that is orthogonal to the set ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14275210/assets/961fdb898db5c70a763b551f25829909e5d13a3ce2e6d314111c9d5752a1fb92.svg) find the value of $\dfrac{a+c}{b}.$
current_example.worked_solution:
The vector $\mathbf{u}$ is orthogonal to the set $W$ if $\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{w}_1=0$ and $\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{w}_2=0.$ So, we need to solve the following system:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14275210/assets/0e296a0f5b3beb89dcc313bd0ad0c9488f23b177261c162cd3538a310836dd59.svg)

We write the corresponding augmented matrix $M$ and reduce it to row echelon form, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & -1 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-1){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

In the reduced matrix above, we have $2$ pivot columns (the $1$st and $2$nd ones), so $x_3$ is a free variable. From the second equation, we get $x_2=-x_3.$ Substituting this into the first equation, we get $x_1=-3x_3.$ So, the general solution is

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14275210/assets/14817c947a345743dbbf1d75ae014cfc5f252b5ef29882923de402bc1972b03d.svg)

Setting $x_3=1,$ we get the vector 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14275210/assets/23966fa8dd43ec77c4c5da699a1845a5045d42f4595b868d2cebac03df849834.svg)

Therefore, we obtain $a=-3,$ $b=-1,$ and $c=1.$

Finally, $\dfrac{a+c}{b}=\dfrac{-3+1}{-1}=2.$
